topic.title: Approvals
topic.shortdesc: Everything the agents want to send, post or change that needs a yes from you. Approve it, reject it, edit it, or send it back with a note.

image.alt: Approvals on a phone: a proposal card with its business, action type, summary, and Reject and Approve buttons.

body.p: Each card is one proposal: the business, the action type (such as email.reply or social.post), a summary, and a preview. A social post shows how it will look on each account, with its character count; a video shows the render. Details shows exactly what will be sent. The task link opens the task that proposed it.
Which actions come here is set per business in the Org page's policies.
Approve runs the action straight away (a scheduled social campaign is queued for its time). Reject drops it. If an approved action fails, its card shows the error, with Copy error and the Full error.

The Approve and Reject buttons on a push notification never act from the lock screen. They open the app on that proposal and ask you to confirm with Yes, approve or Yes, reject. If someone (or another device) already decided it, the page says it is no longer waiting.

Edit shows one field per part of the action: recipients, subject, title and body first. Change what you need and choose Save changes, then Approve. Yes/no settings are checkboxes; structured values are JSON and must stay valid.

When it is easier to say what is wrong than to fix it yourself, choose Ask for changes, write what the agent should change (for example Mention the restock date, and keep it shorter) and choose Send to agent. This proposal is rejected and the agent proposes a new version, which comes back here.
